content: Nkwuri s'agwuribhebhe
Wa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Mosẹs bi, “Kọ rọhng atza akhebha Phero, kkeri kaam nkk'kẹ, ọmaana akhaan-nọng pẹ nsa bi, bẹ agaangi eho, ifha nsi idik s'ipe anọng for kabẹ k'ottem.

Órenga mẹ, ikhina kọ ágbaak va pọ, ọmaana va pa va pọ, eden cha kaam ńneng nnang anọng p'Ijip ihem, ọmaana idik s'ipe anọng for sa kaam nsi kabẹ k'ottem. Bọng biphyir aronga bi, kaam wọ nde Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.”

Mando kwa Mosẹs ọmaana Aarọn afona atza akhebha Phero, agbaakh-ẹ bi, “Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kw'abaHiburu, obeni bi, ‘Ogbe obhir otzuma yan, yina ahakha for sọ k'itzitzikha saam o? Tte anọng paam ọbọhk bẹ afona, ifha bẹ atza akpobh-m.
Idikha abhumi bi, atte bẹ ọbọhk bẹ afona, ophyini, kaam ńdọhm agwuribhebhe ọtzọhm k'ẹkhọma chọ.
Agwuribhebhe mba abubha irerek biphyir maa ọnọng sẹ dọk ore. Bẹ ábira akhibhi ekpo py'iwa arọngda akk'akhibhi arik, ọmaana echi kpenamkpen ch'emeni k'iwoni sabọng.

Bẹ abira afhu k'ihọhm sọ, ọmaana k'ihọhm s'akhaan-nọng pọ, ttara k'ihọhm s'anọng p'Ijip biphyir. Kwẹ óde odik kw'abatte, ttara abatte p'atte an-atzima amara, ttẹwọr kẹ da obhon kw'Ijip ọmaan maa, apyiri ma.’ ” Mẹ wọ, Mosẹs ọbhakhi nnam, obina oji Phero.

Iwa akhaan-nọng mba abọbh Phero bi, “Ogbe obhir otzuma yan, yina ojinọng nwa ọkwọbha man k'eyoma okhe-khe o? Tte bẹ ọbọhk bẹ afona, ifha bẹ afha atza akpobha Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabẹ. Ode bi, kọ atzima ara bi, Ijip owobh k'ihem o?”
Mẹ wọ, Phero ọtzọhm bẹ atza ayeri Mosẹs ọmaana Aarọn akpa nnam, oben bẹ bi, “Bọng nọhng atza akpobha Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng. Yina, bọng anọng bọ ade anọng p'áfon-ofona o?”

Mosẹs obhina bi, “Maman ófona ttara igbọ, ọmaana adeden-nọng, ọmaana va paman p'ijinọnọng, ọmaana p'ipanọnọng, ttara etzirakpo pyaman, okhuri bi, maman ọkhaam bi, mosi ọdadaami kw'ikpokpobha ọnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kwaman.”
Yina, Phero on-oben bẹ bi, “Bọng achibhi bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi owobha kẹ ttara bọng o? K'odik-ọkka, kaam panọng pabọng ọmaana va pabọng ọbọhk kintte bẹ afona. K'odik-ọkka, bọng achibhi itzama.
Mma e! Tte ajinọng bẹ-bẹ afona atza akpobha Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, mada ode odik kw'am-aphyem-m wọ mẹ.” Mẹ wọ, bẹ akhubh Mosẹs ọmaana Aarọn, k'itzitzikha sa Phero.

Mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Mosẹs bi, “Nemi ọbọhk kwọ atzena k'Ijip ifha agwuribhebhe k'ọhaabh atzọkha ibe kpenamkpen, bẹ abira akhibhi ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'omeni k'iwoni, ọmaana ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'arọngda akk'akhibhi arik.”

Mando kwa Mosẹs onemi ochikhura kwẹ otzena k'Ijip. Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi osi ọbhabha ọttẹwọr kẹ da ewuchen em-eyin ogwuma makhọra obhon, m'ẹyawu ttara erungiwu nduma biphyir. Yina ewu ehobha, ọphapha nwa okk'agwuribhebhe otzima okwu.
Agwuribhebhe mba anyaami k'ọhaabh makhọra Ijip. Mada ogbe odede itzama-dema nna s'agwuribhebhe itzimi-mitta k'Ijip, sẹ dọk kíbiri itto, kaambi k'ogbe ororo wọ.

Agwuribhebhe mba abubha irerek biphyir maa, sẹ ipyi erungi bi kaang Bẹ achi ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'arọngda akhibhi arik, ọmaana ekpo py'emeni k'iwoni, ttara achiduk pa nchi. Wa echi, obiro ode ọraraari manda wani kw'obiro otzen-otzeni k'irerek s'Ijip, dọk kode.
M'ẹbhar-ẹbhar, Phero oyeri Mosẹs ọmaana Aarọn, oben bi, “Kaam nkk'ẹkhọngkwuri nsa k'itzitzikha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwọ, ọmaana k'itzitzikha sọ.
Kọ bina anang ẹkhọngkwuri chaam m'ogbe nwa dọk, azi njọhm anang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwọ, ifha ọrọbh-m k'itzama-barada nna.”
Mosẹs obina oji Phero, ọtza ozi njọhm ọnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.

Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọbhakhi ọphapha nwa ọgaangi maa, on-ode mach'ọphapha kw'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-edimi. Wa ọphapha nwa ogwuma agwuribhebhe mba biphyir ọbhari k'Ẹraanga-khora. Ogwuribhebhe manda wani kw'obiro arik k'Ijip kode.
Yina, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi osi Phero ochina ororo ọgaangi eho bi, otte anọng p'Israẹl ọbọhk bẹ afona.
Nkwuri s'orungibanga
Mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Mosẹs bi, “Yaangi ọbọhk kwọ atzena k'ẹrọng, ifha orungibanga kw'ọttọmi ọnọng, óyin obubha Ijip biphyir.”
Mẹ wọ, Mosẹs ọyangi ọbọhk kwẹ otzena k'ẹrọng, orungibanga kw'opyi bi kaang oyin obubha Ijip biphyir, k'iwu manda ittaan.
Ọnọng manda wani kw'ore oyok, yina on-obiro obina oji ibe sẹ k'iwu ittaan kode. Yina, wa anọng p'Israẹl k'ipyerungi k'awobh k'obe fa bẹ arukhi.

Mẹ wọ, Phero oyeri Mosẹs ọmaana Aarọn oben bẹ bi, “Bọng nọhng atza akpobha Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi. Bọng afha tzima panọng pabọng kaambi va pabọng bọ, arọng afona. Bọng kingẹ tte etzirakpo pyabọng ọbọhk ewobha ka.”
Yina, Mosẹs oben bi, “Kọ akhaambi atte man ọbọhk, mọtza osi njafọhni, mobiro osi nnanga nkwọmisẹ ọnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwaman.

Etzirakpo pyaman ẹkhaambi ẹtzọn man abẹ efona, man manda vani kofona oji. Mọkhaambi otzima byani mẹ okpobha Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi. Koyongi bi, mokk'opyiri kẹ, yina moronga ọttọhk fa motzima okpobha Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi e.”
Yina, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ochina ororo osi Phero ọgaangi eho, for kobiro odo bi, otte anọng p'Israẹl ọbọhk bẹ afona.
Mando kwa Phero obeni Mosẹs bi, “Bin-m k'itzitzikha! Aningi dọk ayom bi, abe-m k'itzitzikha o! Kkeri ewu ch'abira are itzitzikha saam ápe-ope.”
Mosẹs obhina bi, “A o, tte kwẹ ode mach'abeni, kaam kọ k'itzitzikha dọk kímbe.”
